paragraphs: Portage CyberTech sells digital identity, electronic signature and verification software to governments and to organizations working under regulation. The company says its solutions can be used on their own or combined with its own or third-party products to build end-to-end systems.

CitizenOne is the identity and access management product, built for the needs of governments, municipalities and the public sector. From a single account, residents can register for and reach services such as permits, payments, renewals, licenses or benefits. They can also manage how their personal information is shared with different departments. On the signature side, CertifiO certifies a signer's identity, professional affiliation or the existence of an organization. ConsignO Cloud is the web platform that carries internal and external signing projects through the whole cycle.

The company describes 25 years of helping people in regulated professions protect their professional identity online. For CertifiO it cites over 60,000 professionals in Canada. For CitizenOne it says the product today supports millions of citizens, professional associations, and dozens of governments and municipalities. A footnote states that certifications are held by Notarius Solutions Inc., a Portage CyberTech company.

quote.text: CitizenOne is a citizen-first digital services solution that consolidates all your services into one user-friendly dashboard.
